g.title: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation event 1
g.desc: (CH₃)₂CO + HO⁻ ⇌ CH₃COCH₂⁻ + H₂O Alpha-H removal gives the C-anion enolate contributor; the enolate is delocalized.

g.text: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation · event 1
(CH₃)₂CO + HO⁻ ⇌ CH₃COCH₂⁻ + H₂O
Alpha-H removal gives the C-anion enolate contributor; the enolate is delocalized.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation event 2
g.desc: CH₃COCH₂⁻ + (CH₃)₂CO → CH₃COCH₂C(O⁻)(CH₃)₂ Enolate C → acetone C; acceptor C=O π pair → O.

g.text: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation · event 2
CH₃COCH₂⁻ + (CH₃)₂CO → CH₃COCH₂C(O⁻)(CH₃)₂
Enolate C → acetone C; acceptor C=O π pair → O.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation event 3
g.desc: CH₃COCH₂C(O⁻)(CH₃)₂ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COCH₂C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻ Alkoxide protonation by water produces diacetone alcohol and regenerates base.

g.text: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation · event 3
CH₃COCH₂C(O⁻)(CH₃)₂ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COCH₂C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻
Alkoxide protonation by water produces diacetone alcohol and regenerates base.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation event 4
g.desc: CH₃COCH₂C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻ ⇌ CH₃COCH⁻C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + H₂O Second alpha deprotonation forms the E1cB precursor; no carbonyl bond is broken.

g.text: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation · event 4
CH₃COCH₂C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻ ⇌ CH₃COCH⁻C(OH)(CH₃)₂ + H₂O
Second alpha deprotonation forms the E1cB precursor; no carbonyl bond is broken.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation event 5
g.desc: CH₃COCH⁻C(OH)(CH₃)₂ → CH₃COCH=C(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻ Enolate C pair → alpha/beta C=C; beta C–O pair → O. Mesityl oxide has no E/Z at this alkene.

g.text: Base-catalyzed aldol condensation · event 5
CH₃COCH⁻C(OH)(CH₃)₂ → CH₃COCH=C(CH₃)₂ + HO⁻
Enolate C pair → alpha/beta C=C; beta C–O pair → O. Mesityl oxide has no E/Z at this alkene.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
